meta.name: multi-omics-integration
meta.description: Integrate multiple ENCODE data types (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, Histone ChIP-seq, TF ChIP-seq) for a tissue/cell type to build a comprehensive regulatory landscape. Use when the user wants to answer "what are the enhancers, promoters, and regulatory elements active in my tissue, and which transcription factors control them?" by layering expression, chromatin accessibility, histone marks, and TF binding data. Follows the Mawla et al. 2023 framework for cross-assay integration of islet cell type-specific data. Handles chromatin state annotation (ChromHMM), enhancer-gene linkage, TF motif enrichment, and cell type-specific regulatory element identification. Use for ANY multi-omic analysis, enhancer discovery, regulatory network construction, or epigenomic characterization using ENCODE data.
